name: Wave Patrol
source:
Fresh from completing FBI training, a biochemistry graduate heads to Miami to visit her college roommate. There, Kim uncovers a wave of mysterious drug overdoses, disappearances, and murders affecting the city’s beaches. 

Tasked with investigating undercover, she must track down the culprit behind these disturbing events.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Wave_Patrol]romance-club.fandom[/url]
